svg.title: Arcade circles: same Straight, different Turn
svg.desc: An animation of an XRP seen from above on a whiteboard panel, drawn to scale, with a marker in the hole between its wheels. Four buttons run Arcade with Straight 0.5 and Turn 0.15, 0.3, 0.5 or 0.8. Each drives one full circle from the same starting mark and draws it in blue, with a purple target at the point it circles, and a panel shows the two wheel efforts Arcade works out. Positive Turn bends left. Turn 0.15: both wheels forward, the left one slower, a circle about 50 cm across. Turn 0.3: about 25 cm across. Turn 0.5: the left wheel stops and the robot swings around it, about 15 cm across. Turn 0.8: the left wheel runs backward and the circle is about 10 cm across, smaller than the robot.
svg.text: More Turn means a bigger gap
